title: Cool Font: Maintained
description: This project aims to continue support of the "Cool Font" texture pack for future versions and fix any bugs that may come from using the pack in newer versions.
body:
# Note for Prism Launcher Users
Select the correct version, I cannot the order that the versions appear is based strictly on the order that they were uploaded to Modrinth, so if I had to fix something in one version it is stuck at the top of the list and is the default version for Prism Launcher to select until I upload a a different version that is then put at the top of the list.

# What is Cool Font: Maintained?
This is an updated, maintained version of the "Cool Font" resource pack. My goal is to make sure that the resource pack works with all future versions of the game so people can continue to use the resource pack with no issues.

You may be wondering if I will ever add more glyphs to the pack if Minecraft adds new ones. The answer is probobly not, but maybe if I'm feeling like it one day, the main reason for this is I am by no means good at art, you might even say I suck at it.

# Cool Font: Maintained Preview
See the [gallery](https://modrinth.com/project/a0g0aP9j/gallery) for a big preview of a bunch of the characters in the resource pack!

# Reporting Bugs
Report any and all bugs that you find with the pack at the [Codeberg link](https://codeberg.org/Bobiloosky/coolfont-maintained/issues) in the top-right of this page. Please do report bugs, thats kinda the whole point of this project. I'm not really adding anything to the pack, just quietly making sure it runs smoothly in the background. I'm like a little resource pack fairy.
